chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from one of our companions, from Abu Al-Hasan Al-Reza (peace be upon him), who said:

Whoever prays the Maghrib prayer, and after it prays four Rak'at, and does not speak until he has prayed ten Rak'at, reciting in each Rak'at Al-Hamd and Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad, it would be equivalent to (freeing) ten necks (of slaves).
ai.seo_question: What is the method and reward of praying the Salat of Sayyida Fatima (peace be upon her)?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi details the specific ritual of the Salat of Sayyida Fatima (peace be upon her), prescribing four Rak'at after Maghrib with continuous recitation of Al-Fatiha and Al-Ikhlas without speech. The reward is equated to freeing ten slaves, a virtue often linked to the night prayers of the Prophet's daughter and the Imams. This practice underscores the Shia emphasis on consistent, silent devotion and the spiritual merit of specific Quranic recitations in voluntary prayers.
